1. Heard on misc. application No.01/23 for taking compromise deed on record.
2. For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
The compromise deed is taken on record.

3. By way of these criminal misc. petitions under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the accused-petitioners have approached this Court with a prayer to quash the FIR No.137/2023 registered at Police Station Moti Dungri, District [2023:RJ-JP:30864] (3 of 3)
[CRLMP-6809/2023] Jaipur (East) for the offences punishable under Sections 384, 420, 406, 467,
468, 471 & 120-B of IPC.

The written compromise has been filed in these petitions.
5. Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant do not dispute the aforesaid factual position.
